Integrated multiple L1/L2 chain backends into the exchange — including the Sui listing — and maintained them under production load.

Shipped React + Node.js microservices for self-sovereign identity and credential verification — REST APIs, Docker, AWS.
Delivered across distributed teams spanning EU, Singapore, and India.
Led a 4-engineer team building a real-estate platform from zero to production; owned architecture, infrastructure, and hiring.
Created and maintain 18+ open-source npm libraries (auth, real-time graphs, transport, storage) — github.com/HydreIO.
